    Shift orthogonality on additive control windows #

    Pairwise nonidentity shift-Hom vanishing for a finite family of indecomposable modules extends to every finite biproduct in its additive hull. This is the bridge from residual separation of the manuscript's finite vertex set to fullness of push-down on the categorical window that contains relevant factorization cores.
